page.overview:
Who is Candy Person 35?

Pink Bubblegum Bubble is a minor character who first appears in "From Bad to Worse" as a candy zombie. In "Dream of Love," he tries to calm down Jam Jam, who is upset by Tree Trunks and Mr. Pig's kissing.

In the video game Adventure Time: Finn & Jake Investigations, Pink Bubblegum Bubble is frequently the target of practical jokes by Magic Man and has to be rescued or helped by the player on several occasions.

He looks like a pink bubblegum sphere with thin arms and legs.
